getDefaultOptions.js

 
import { getDefaultOptions as getInternalDefaultOptions } from "./_lib/defaultOptions.js";

Returns an object that contains defaults for options.locale, options.weekStartsOn and options.firstWeekContainsDate arguments for all functions.

You can change these with setDefaultOptions.

 
export function getDefaultOptions() {
  return Object.assign({}, getInternalDefaultOptions());
}

Fallback for modularized imports:

 
export default getDefaultOptions;
